definitions.gloss: letter of appointment; official notice of personnel change
definitions.explanation: A formal document issued by an organization notifying an employee of appointment, promotion, transfer, or other personnel changes.

examples.japanese: {転勤|てんきん}の{辞令|じれい}が{出|で}た。
{昇進|しょうしん}の{辞令|じれい}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
{来月|らいげつ}の{人事異動|じんじいどう}の{辞令|じれい}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The personnel change notices for next month were announced.

notes:
{辞令|じれい} is a formal document used in Japanese companies and organizations.

TYPES:
- {採用|さいよう}{辞令|じれい}: appointment letter
- {昇進|しょうしん}{辞令|じれい}: promotion notice
- {転勤|てんきん}{辞令|じれい}: transfer notice
- {異動|いどう}{辞令|じれい}: personnel change notice
- {退職|たいしょく}{辞令|じれい}: retirement notice

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {辞令|じれい}が{出|で}る: to receive an official notice
- {辞令|じれい}を{受|う}ける: to receive an appointment
- {内示|ないじ}: informal notice (before official {辞令|じれい})

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese companies, {辞令|じれい} is typically issued at the beginning of the fiscal year (April) when major personnel changes occur.
